test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Train A leaves station M at 6:30 AM and reaches station N at 3:30 PM on the same day. Train B leaves station N at 8:30 AM and reaches station M at 1:30 PM on the same day. Find the time when trains A and B meet.
solution:
**Given:**

Train A leaves station M at 6:30 AM

Train A reaches station N at 3:30 PM

Train B leaves station N at 8:30 AM

Train B reaches station M at 1:30 PM

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Relative Speed = Sum of speeds (when moving towards each other)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time taken by Train A = 3:30 PM − 6:30 AM = 9 hours

⇒ Time taken by Train B = 1:30 PM − 8:30 AM = 5 hours

Let total distance between M and N be A km.

⇒ Speed of Train A = A ÷ 9

⇒ Speed of Train B = A ÷ 5

Train A starts at 6:30 AM and Train B at 8:30 AM.

⇒ Train A travels alone for 2 hours before Train B starts.

⇒ Distance covered by Train A in 2 hours = (A ÷ 9) × 2 = 2A ÷ 9

⇒ Remaining distance = A − 2A ÷ 9 = 7A ÷ 9

Let the time after which they meet (after 8:30 AM) be B hours.

⇒ (A ÷ 9)B + (A ÷ 5)B = 7A ÷ 9

⇒ B(1 ÷ 9 + 1 ÷ 5) = 7 ÷ 9

⇒ B(5 + 9) ÷ 45 = 7 ÷ 9

⇒ B × 14 ÷ 45 = 7 ÷ 9

⇒ B = (7 ÷ 9) × (45 ÷ 14)

⇒ B = (7 × 45) ÷ (9 × 14)

⇒ B = 315 ÷ 126

⇒ B = 2.5 hours

⇒ 2.5 hours = 2 hours 30 minutes

⇒ Meeting time = 8:30 AM + 2 hours 30 minutes

⇒ Meeting time = 11:00 AM

**∴ The trains will meet at 11:00 AM.**
